routes.name: Mali Tourist Entry Visa
routes.summary: Most travelers need a visa before arriving. The embassy says visas are not issued at the airport. You apply online, then the embassy issues the visa.

other: Embassy page says no visas at the airport on arrival.
Visa-free list, visa length and fee not confirmed on official pages. Check the Malian embassy covering your country.

steps: Fill in the online application and upload documents.
Wait for a reference number by email.
Email the reference number to the embassy and pay the fee.
Bring passport and documents to the embassy if required in your country.
documents: Invitation letter from a local partner or travel agent, stamped
